definitions.gloss: political world; political circles; the world of politics
definitions.explanation: The collective sphere of political activity, including politicians, parties, and the institutions of government. Used in news and commentary to refer to the political establishment.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}から{引退|いんたい}することを{表明|ひょうめい}した。
examples.english: He announced his retirement from politics.

examples.japanese: そのスキャンダルは{政界|せいかい}に{大|おお}きな{衝撃|しょうげき}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The scandal sent shockwaves through the political world.

notes:
USAGE:
{政界|せいかい} is a formal term frequently used in news reporting. It follows the common 〜{界|かい} (world/sphere) pattern used for professional domains.

RELATED 〜{界|かい} COMPOUNDS:
- {財界|ざいかい} (financial world / business circles)
- {官界|かんかい} (bureaucratic circles)
- {学界|がっかい} (academic world)
- {芸能界|げいのうかい} (entertainment industry)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政界|せいかい}に{入|はい}る (to enter politics)
- {政界|せいかい}を{引退|いんたい}する (to retire from politics)
- {政界|せいかい}{再編|さいへん} (political realignment)
- {政界|せいかい}の{重鎮|じゅうちん} (political heavyweight)
